title: Glowing paper boat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='water' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#3ec6ff'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#1a6fbf'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='boatA' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#fff7c2'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#ffd23f'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='boatB' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ffe680'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#f2a619'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- glow halo -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='40' ry='26' fill='#ffe58a' opacity='0.18'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='26' ry='17' fill='#fff2b0' opacity='0.22'/>

  <!-- water -->
  <path d='M2 74 Q14 68 26 74 T50 74 T74 74 T98 74 L98 98 L2 98 Z' fill='url(#water)'/>
  <path d='M2 82 Q16 76 30 82 T58 82 T86 82 T98 82' fill='none' stroke='#7fe0ff' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.8'/>
  <path d='M6 90 Q20 85 34 90 T62 90 T90 90' fill='none' stroke='#a8ecff' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- hull -->
  <path d='M18 60 L82 60 L66 76 Q50 80 34 76 Z' fill='url(#boatA)'/>
  <!-- hull shading / folded flaps -->
  <path d='M18 60 L50 60 L42 76 Q34 77 34 76 Z' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <path d='M82 60 L50 60 L58 76 Q66 77 66 76 Z' fill='#f2a619'/>
  <!-- hull top rim highlight -->
  <path d='M18 60 L82 60 L79 64 L21 64 Z' fill='#fffbe0' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- keel fold -->
  <path d='M50 60 L50 79' stroke='#e08e0b' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- sail / middle peak -->
  <path d='M50 20 L50 58 L30 58 Z' fill='url(#boatB)'/>
  <path d='M50 20 L50 58 L70 58 Z' fill='#ffcf4d'/>
  <path d='M50 20 L50 58 L58 58 Z' fill='#ffe89a' opacity='0.9'/>
  <!-- sail folds -->
  <path d='M50 24 L50 56' stroke='#d97f06' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.6'/>
  <path d='M46 30 L46 56' stroke='#d97f06' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.35'/>
  <path d='M54 30 L54 56' stroke='#fff2b0' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <path d='M78 30 l1.6 4.4 4.4 1.6 -4.4 1.6 -1.6 4.4 -1.6 -4.4 -4.4 -1.6 4.4 -1.6 Z' fill='#fff6c8'/>
  <path d='M24 34 l1.2 3.2 3.2 1.2 -3.2 1.2 -1.2 3.2 -1.2 -3.2 -3.2 -1.2 3.2 -1.2 Z' fill='#fff6c8' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='26' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='22' r='1.4' fill='#fffbe0' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
